rules.name: GitHub
rules.description: Skip the code viewer, diffs and the file tree — identifiers are not prose and translating them makes the page unreadable.

rules.name: Hacker News
rules.description: Skip the score/age/comment-count lines and the top navigation.

rules.name: Wikipedia
rules.description: Skip references, navigation boxes and the [edit] links; keep the article body.

rules.name: YouTube — unclamp video titles
rules.description: Grid and sidebar titles are clamped to two lines, which cuts the translation off. Lift the clamp while the page is translated.
rules.injectCss: ytd-rich-grid-media #video-title, ytd-compact-video-renderer #video-title, ytd-video-renderer #video-title { -webkit-line-clamp: unset !important; max-height: none !important; }
